SELECT r.id, 
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.driver_id, 0) <> 0 THEN CONCAT_WS(' ', d.first_name, d.last_name)

            WHEN COALESCE(r.lose_affiliate, 0) <> 0 THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(l.name, ''), l.operator_name)

FROM tbl_reservations r JOIN tbl_order o ON o.reservation_id = r.id

GROUP BY UPPER(o.currency) ORDER BY total DESC
